ruleDefinitions.name: Imports Registry Key From an ADS
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the import of a alternate datastream to the registry with regedit.exe.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\regedit\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "REGEDIT\.EXE") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/i\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.reg.*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(":[^ \]"))) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-e\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-a\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ .*")))
